title: At 9, she started feeding hungry children; now her nonprofit has reached over 110,000 people
summary_full: New Jersey teenager Anakh Sawhney started Rice Kids in 2018, aged nine, to provide meals to hungry children. Her nonprofit has since supported more than 110,000 people across five US states and parts of India through food, education, healthcare and other essential resources. More than half of the students supported by the organisation in India have returned to mainstream education.
